what: The learner of phase B (model/learner.py) on four cases small enough to work by hand: which windows it judges and how, its sums, D, the peak, the set, its counters, the outcome of each host operation, and every score record of the run.
how_worked: By hand, on paper, with the sums written in each case's 'worked' lines; and again by a short script of the parcel's own that imports nothing of the tree, before any line of model/learner.py was written (the parcel's ledger, 2026-11-25 20:52). No line of model/ or learn/ produced any number here. The rule as the design states it: a label-0 window is frames j-T..j-1, judged when the core's next index is j, skipped START if j < T, BUSY if the record before is less than 2T before, FULL if its count is at its most; a label-1 window is frames j..j+T-1, judged at next index j+T, skipped BUSY if a record is less than T before or after, FULL likewise. D[c][k] = S1[k][c] * n0 - S0[k][c] * n1, in the order channel 0's taps, channel 1's, ...; m the largest magnitude; each coefficient the integer nearest D * 131071 / m, a tie to the even one.

conventions.start_blob: the matched-filter configuration of the case's profile and taps: one filter reading every channel, every coefficient 0, the rectifier passing, a pool of 1, a shift of 0, a head weight of 1
conventions.truth: records of amplitude 0/1 and pulse id 0 at truth_indexes, handed to the learner directly with the frames as given: they are closer than a pulse, so the injector would refuse them, and the learner reads only their indexes
conventions.write_shadow_start: a write_shadow whose argument is the start blob
conventions.sums: sum_label_0 and sum_label_1 are [tap][channel], tap 0 meeting the window's oldest frame
conventions.scores: every score record of the run as [index, epoch, flags, score]

cases.name: s16x1-the-tie

no_truth.scores: every score 0, epoch 0 for indexes 0 to 14 and epoch 1 for 15 to 17, flags 0

worked: Records at 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 with T = 2: each is T after the one before.
Label 0 of 2 is frames 0, 1 = -32768, 0, judged at next index 2: 2 >= T and no record before: taken.
Label 0 of 4, 6, 8, 10: each record is 2 after the one before, less than 2T = 4: BUSY, four times.
Label 1 of j is frames j, j+1, judged at j + 2: the record after is exactly T on, not less: taken, five times: (32767, 1), (32767, 0), (32767, 0), (1, 0), (0, 0).
m = 262142 = 2 * 131071. Tap 0: 262142 * 131071 / 262142 = 131071. Tap 1: 131071 / 262142 = 1/2 exactly, a tie: to the even 0. Half away from zero gives 1.
The trainer's weights are S1 / 5 - S0 / 1 = (262142/5, 1/5): the same ratio, so the same tie.
The update is named at next index 5 for 12, made at 12 after label 1 of 10, finished at 12 + 3 = 15.
At 7 a shadow write: 7 < 15, UPDATE_UNFINISHED. At 13 a commit for 16: 13 < 15, UPDATE_UNFINISHED, lrn_early 1. At 15 the commit for 15 is taken.

No truth record: both counts stay 0, D is all zero, the update makes no set (QUANTISE_INPUT) and is unmade at 15; the commit at 13 is still refused, and the one at 15 swaps in the shadow, which holds the start's zeros.

cases.name: s16x1-start-and-an-unmade-update
worked: Records at 1 and 5 with T = 2.
Label 0 of 1 would be frames -1, 0: 1 < T, START.

Label 1 of 1 is frames 1, 2 = (3, -1), judged at 3: taken. Label 0 of 5 is frames 3, 4 = (2, 0), judged at 5: 5 - 1 = 4 = 2T exactly, not less: taken. Label 1 of 5 is frames 5, 6 = (4, 5), judged at 7: taken.
Update named at 2 for 3, made at 3: n0 = 0, n1 = 1, S0 = (0, 0), S1 = (3, -1): D = (3 * 0 - 0 * 1, -1 * 0 - 0 * 1) = (0, 0): no peak, QUANTISE_INPUT. Finished at 3 + 3 = 6: lrn_unmade 1.
At 4 an update for 7: 4 < 6, UPDATE_UNFINISHED, not counted in lrn_early. At 6 the same: taken.

Taken, label 0 of 1 = the zero before frame 0 and frame 0 = (0, 0): at 3, n0 = n1 = 1, S0 = (0, 0), S1 = (3, -1): D = (3, -1), m = 3: 131071 and -131071 / 3 = -43690.33..., nearest -43690. Made where the learner's is unmade; and count0 is 2 at the end.

cases.name: s24x3-ties-on-three-channels
worked: Records at 2 and 6 with T = 2. Label 0 of 2: frames 0, 1. Label 1 of 2: frames 2, 3, at 4. Label 0 of 6: frames 4, 5, at 6; 6 - 2 = 4 = 2T, not less: taken. Label 1 of 6: frames 6, 7, at 8. All four taken; n0 = n1 = 2.
Update named at 0 for 8, made at 8 after label 1 of 6, finished at 11; the commit at 11 is taken.

cases.name: s24x3-full-at-a-small-count
worked: count_bits = 2: at most 3 windows a label. This is a small build's width; the definition's is 32.
Records at 1, 3, 5, 7 with T = 1: a label-0 window is frame j - 1, judged at j; a label-1 window is frame j, judged at j + 1. Each record is 2 = 2T after the one before: free.

Taken: label 0 = frames 0, 2, 4 = (1,0,0), (0,0,1), (0,1,0); label 1 = frames 1, 3, 5 = (0,2,0), (3,0,0), (0,0,2). Label 0 of 7 (frame 6) at 7 and label 1 of 7 (frame 7) at 8: each count is at 3: FULL, twice.
At next index 8, after label 1 of 7 is judged: the update for 8 is made at once, and with no update time finished at once; the commit for 8 is taken.
